charges.testimony: The Smiling Peddler was a liar and worse. But they cut him down in the market road, in front of the children.
Corwin stole a sack of grain for his sister's children. This one killed him for it. I buried him myself.
Orsk was on his knees. He'd dropped his blade. They executed him anyway. I was there. I saw it.
Dunn threw down his crossbow at Ashford. He was done fighting. This one killed him for it.
I had one skull to sell and two girls to feed. They took the skull. One of my girls didn't see the spring.
I painted that eye forty years ago, when I was young and stupid. I was punished for it in front of my whole chapel.
Brother Hale was a scholar. He was going to teach the Old Tongue to the world. They ended him.
Saltjaw Mott was a wrecker, aye. But we watched them drown him off the rocks like a sack of cats.
Ansel was sick. He was trying. I saw this one put him down like a dog.
Garret was Ashford's to judge. They took it out of my hands and judged him themselves.
My brother sold patrol times for bread. They killed him on the village green. I came to see their face. I'll never forget it.
Gorran kept the Bastille's keys and gave the sick his bread. I know. I paid him. They left him dead with the keys in his hand.
Ossian sold skulls, like I counted them. Now his own is on a Bone Choir altar.
The Pilgrim of the Sun was harmless. They took his charm and sold it. The bees wouldn't go near them after.
My husband was in the ice ten years. He came back, and this one sent him back to the snow.
Brother Vael was a counter, not a killer. They killed him in his own fortress.
(The Captain calls Brother Vael. Nobody answers. Branded men don't live long once the cult finds them.)
She was trying to make it right. She was teaching me to stop. They killed her beside her own pits.
There is still a blood pit under that church. They let her keep it. 'For research.' It is not empty.
(The Captain calls Pell, the grower who was going to testify against the cartel. Nobody in the valley knows where he went.)
We shook hands. Then they sold me out. I'm a criminal, your honour, but I keep my word.
Thirty years I waited for that journal. They sold it to the Gilded Hand before I'd read the first page.
They were beaten. They were kneeling. They were ended anyway.
Oh, they took the Hand's gold, your honour. I weighed it myself. Every coin.

open: This court of the Watch is in session. The accused stands before us in chains.
We found them asleep, your honour. They didn't wake until we'd tied them. We have witnesses.
script.silent_witness: The Captain calls {witness}. Silence. 'The witness cannot be found, your honour.'
villagers: {n} of our people were killed by the accused. We have their names. We will read them if you want.
stores: They broke into our stores. {n} chests, emptied. Winter stores, some of them.
hand: I watched them collect for the Gilded Hand. {n} times that I saw. Probably more.
shrines: I saw them kneel at a golden eye on the road. They prayed to it, your honour. It answered.
plea: You have heard the witnesses. How do you plead?
no_case: There is no case here. Whoever brought this one in wasted the court's night. Take them home.
acquitted: The court is not convinced. The accused is free to go. Do not make us regret it.
guilty: Guilty. The accused will serve {days} in the obsidian cells.
bribe_worked: The jury cannot agree. One of them can't seem to stop looking at the floor. The accused is free to go.
bribe_failed: The jury is agreed. Even the one who was paid. Guilty: {days} in the obsidian cells.

pleas.label: Guilty
pleas.hint: A shorter sentence, if the court has a case.

pleas.label: Not guilty
pleas.hint: A gamble: walk free, or serve longer.

pleas.label: Say nothing
pleas.hint: Let the court decide on the evidence alone.

pleas.label: Pay a juror (16 emeralds from your things)
pleas.hint: The Gilded Hand knows which juror. Needs Hand rank and 16 emeralds.
